purpose: rule(output_to_genfiles=True): with --incompatible_merge_genfiles_directory (default true) the genfiles root is the bin root (BuildConfigurationValue.java:430-434), so declared and predeclared outputs and ctx.genfiles_dir are in bazel-out/<cfg>/bin. Motivation: capnproto's capnp_gen (OSS corpus B20).

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8; fresh fixture copy per case

normalization: <WS> = the workspace copy. stdout = the query output lines. debug_sorted = the analysis DEBUG lines without the `DEBUG: <file>:L:C: ` prefix, sorted ; errors = the `ERROR: <WS>...` lines.
